title: LIFE AND DEATH SET BEFORE YOU

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "See, I set before you today life and prosperity, death and destruction. For I command you today to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him, and to keep his commands, decrees and laws; then you will live and increase, and the Lord your God will bless you in the land you are entering to possess." — Deut 30:15-16 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses sets the choice before the people as plainly as possible: "life and prosperity, death and destruction." Two paths lie open, and everything hangs on which one they choose. And at the heart of the path of life is this: "to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him." Life is found not merely in keeping rules, but in loving God and walking closely with Him.

This is one of the great themes of Scripture — that our choices matter, that God sets a real decision before us, and that the path we take leads either toward life or away from it. God does not force us; He sets the options before us and calls us, lovingly and urgently, to choose well.

Notice that the way of life begins with love. God does not want cold, mechanical obedience. He wants hearts that love Him, from which glad obedience naturally flows. To choose life is to choose God Himself — to treasure Him above all and walk with Him day by day.

Ultimately, this choice of life and death points us to Christ, who said, "I am the way and the truth and the life" (John 14:6). He is the life that God sets before us. To choose Him is to choose life; to reject Him is to remain in death. And wonderfully, Jesus came so that we "may have life, and have it to the full" (John 10:10). The path of life is not a burden but a gift. Choose God. Choose His way. Choose the life found in Christ.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I actively choosing the path of life, or drifting toward death?
2. Is my obedience rooted in love for God, or mere duty?
3. What would it look like to "choose life" in a decision I face today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You set life and death before me, and I choose life — I choose You. Fill my heart with love for You, that obedience may flow from love. Thank You that Christ is my life. Amen.
